text_block_list.text: Under the pretext of "let's experience some chills together and unwind!", I followed Transcend's lead to a hot spring inn deep in the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Landlady
text_block_list.text:
Because our inn is nestled deep in the mountains, there is no cell reception at all.
Please disconnect from digital devices and enjoy a relaxing stay.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Our phones won't work past this point...
Ooh, I'm getting chills, Trainer-chan!

"A digital detox"—
It was Transcend's idea, saying,
"I want to do something fun with you, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, alright then, right away!
Shall we go hit the hot springs?!

There were several hot springs
scattered near the inn.

Among them, Transcend seemed to have her eye on
the hot spring located deepest in the mountains,
which was said to have the most therapeutic waters.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
They say the path there is pretty steep.
Some sources even treat it like a secret hidden hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Still... since we're already here!
Don't you wanna try out the ultimate healing effect?!

The further I tread, the steeper the path becomes,
with layer upon layer of branches closing off my sight...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
They said to turn right at the big rock...
but there's nothing like that here, right?
Did we take a wrong turn...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I left my smartphone at the inn...
This map is our only lifeline!
choice_data_list: Even looking at the map, I can't tell where we are...
Even looking at the map, I can't tell where we are...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Wait, are you lost...?
choice_data_list: It's okay, let's search the area again—

text_block_list.text:
Just as a massive clap of thunder roared,
a heavy downpour instantly began to fall.
choice_data_list: Let's take shelter from the rain over there!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Guh...! Just a little more!
choice_data_list: Wait, Tran! Watch your step!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?
choice_data_list: Tran! Are you oka— Whoa!?

text_block_list.text:
Panicking and trying to rush over to Transcend as she sank to her knees in the mud,
I ended up tripping and tumbling over myself.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan!?
H-Hold on! Come on, let's hurry, but be careful!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Brrr, so cold!
I'm totally soaked...!
choice_data_list: The map's soaking wet too...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. I'm sorry, Trainy.
I never thought it would turn out like this..."

Saying so, Transcend cast her eyes downward.
Just as I opened my mouth to say something to her—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I'm really, really sorry!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I'm getting absolute chills right now...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I mean, that was totally entering the unknown! Pfft... And seeing you get stuck in the mud out of worry for me, Trai-chan, was way too hilarious!
choice_data_list: Geez, it's not a laughing ma—... *snort*!

text_block_list.text:
When my eyes met Transcend's mud-covered face,
I couldn't help but laugh.
We were a complete mess, but our spirits were bright and clear.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you're laughing too, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yeah, this is so good.
Having you right next to me, Trainer, totally gives me the chills.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, I ab-so-lutely love the moments when I'm savoring the "real deal" with you, Trainer.
It satisfies me—right to my core!
choice_data_list: I love the time I spend with you too, Tran.
I love spending time with you too, Tran.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Heheh... We're totally on the same wavelength, aren't we?♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, did the rain stop?
They really weren't kidding about mountain weather changing fast.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's roll, Trai-chan!
Our adventure ain't over yet!
choice_data_list: The map's totally useless, so what should we do?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, can't you smell it, Trainer-chan?
Look, it's wafting right over... That subtle scent of sulfur from the open-air bath!
choice_data_list: It's true?!

text_block_list.text:
Pushing through the trees and treading firmly on the ground,
we followed the narrow animal trail all the way... until a small open-air bath appeared.

Practically tumbling in,
I submerged myself into the hot bath—

Listening to the pleasant sounds of nature,
I took a long, relaxing soak in the hot spring.
It felt as though the fatigue in my body and mind was melting away—

I soaked in the bath, chatting idly with Transcend.
It felt as though the fatigue of mind and body
was simply melting away—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trai-chan!
How was the hot spring?
choice_data_list: That was the best...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whew, that was a lovely bath.
choice_data_list: That was the best...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It really soaked right into
our muddy, chilled-to-the-bone bodies, didn't it?
choice_data_list: Ah... But that was really rough, wasn't it?
Yeah... But that really must have been tough.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Right. If you wanna pursue the ultimate "real thing," you can't forget the ultimate prep!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, the map's all dry.
With this, we can take a "safe" stroll on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, maybe... I might end up
getting just a wiiittle bit muddy... though?
choice_data_list: Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
In search of even greater thrills...
let's keep charging ahead, Trainy!

After thoroughly enjoying the secluded hot spring,
I begin walking slowly back toward the inn.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
When we get back, wanna hit the inn's hot springs too?
Since we're here, we might as well conquer every bath~!
choice_data_list: Thanks for being so soothing and comforting, Tran.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan... you've completely let your guard down, huh?
The power of the hot springs is terrifying.
choice_data_list: It's important, so I wanted to tell you properly.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aww, don't worry about it.
If Trainer-chan isn't full of energy, it's just no fun, y'know?
For me, that is♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm, so good~
See? My snack picks never miss, right?
choice_data_list: So yummy~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
My HP's pretty much all recovered~
Spending time like this with you really is important, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-chan.
Let's keep walking side-by-side
and go see all kinds of sights together, yeah?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's a promise.
Yeah, it's a promise, okay?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Heheh... Yup, that's a promise.
